description.value:
The robot companion morphs its features to reveal the machinery writhing beneath its synthetic skin. It attempts to Demoralize a creature using Deception instead of Intimidation. This display gains the visual trait and does not require a language. While frightened by this ability, the target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} to your robot companion.

@Localize[SFMTP.ManualActionHint]

Archives of Nethys · Tech Core, p. 73
